a:r.a:t: Passwords stored as bcrypt hashes (bcryptjs) — never in plain text.
Every query is a prepared statement — structurally safe from SQL injection.
HTTP-only session cookies (7-day), role checks on every protected route.
multer enforces MIME allow-list (images + PDF) and an 8 MB / file cap.
the Express session secret is currently hardcoded and flagged “change-in-production” — it should move to an environment variable / secret before any real deployment.
